justification: Minimal repair replaces the bare EL verb with its morphologically integrated infinitive form. The 'vamos a + infinitive' frame forces the infinitive shape uniquely; no tense ambiguity.

provenance.review_disagreement: Independent blind reviewer repaired to 'Vamos a scanear el recibo.' -- an attested alternate integration spelling alongside the prefixed 'escanear', not a different construction. Added as alternate_repairs.
